name: twx-parser
description: Local parser, browser, dependency explorer, and analyzer for IBM BAW TWX packages

scripts.test: node test-analyzer-v2.js && node test-analyzer-ui.js && node test-architecture-presentation.js && node test-dependency-security.js
scripts.lint: eslint src/parser/analyzer.js test-analyzer-v2.js test-analyzer-ui.js test-architecture-presentation.js test-dependency-security.js
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{fs.unlinkSync('dist/twx-parser.exe')}catch(e){if(e.code!=='ENOENT')throw e}; fs.rmSync('output', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('output');" && pkg . --out-path dist --targets node18-win-x64

author: João Marques <joao.gsilva.marques@gmail.com>
